routes.name: tool

tools.title: Body & State Check
tools.purpose: Map what your body and surroundings are dealing with before deciding what a feeling means.

fields.label: Anything worth checking right now?
Something else

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Body Check
tools.purpose: Map what your body is doing before deciding what it means.

fields.label: Where do you notice something?
What kind of sensation?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Mixed Feelings
tools.purpose: Name more than one feeling without forcing them into agreement.

fields.label: Which feelings can coexist?
What does each feeling seem connected to?
What could make room for all of them?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Emotion Timeline
tools.purpose: Trace how feelings changed over an event, without assuming one is the “real” one.

fields.label: What was present first?
What changed next?
What came after that?
What happened between each shift?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Feelings Check-In
tools.purpose: Build a clearer map of one feeling, its urge, what matters and what—if anything—you want to do.

fields.label: What word or words fit best?
Where were you, and what was happening just before it?
What do you notice in your body or energy?
What are you drawn to do, if anything?
What might matter or need attention here?
Would you prefer comfort, information, company, a boundary, action, or simply to leave this unanswered?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Brain Dump
tools.purpose: Empty your head, separate thoughts by what they need, and choose only the next useful attention.

fields.label: Put it all here. No order needed.
What would be helpful to see first?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Thought Map
tools.purpose: Map the tangle, then reality-check it, prepare a conversation, compare options, or build a clear next thread.

fields.label: What is the main situation?
Who or what is connected?
What questions keep showing up?
What seems connected, and what might be separate?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Reality Map
tools.purpose: Sort the moment into camera, narrator, feeling and missing footage, then test the story and choose a response without perfect certainty.

fields.label: Observed: what could a camera or transcript capture?
Interpreted: what are you making it mean?
Unknown: what information is missing?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: CBT Journal
tools.purpose: Investigate a difficult thought as a hypothesis: separate facts, story, feeling, action and one fair next test.
tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Assumption Finder
tools.purpose: Find the hidden “must”, “always”, or “this means” inside a thought.

fields.label: Write the thought you want to inspect.
What needs to be true for this thought to be completely right?
Which assumptions are observations, and which could be checked?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Rumination Check
tools.purpose: Notice when another round of thinking is helping, or when a different move may help more.

fields.label: What question or uncertainty keeps returning?
What would help now?
What is the smallest next move?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Sensory Reset
tools.purpose: Notice the sensory mismatch, change one variable, and learn what helps your system right now.

fields.label: What fits the moment?
What usually feels okay for you?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Grounding
tools.purpose: Re-establish where you are, what is happening now, and what your senses can confirm.

fields.label: One thing you can see, if you want.
One sound or silence you notice.
A point of contact, temperature, texture or movement.
What helps you know where and when you are?
Would you like an optional slow breath or movement?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Sensory Profile
tools.purpose: Notice preferences across settings; seeking, avoiding and “depends” can all be true.

fields.label: Choose an area to explore.
How does it usually feel?
What setting or context changes the answer?
What small adjustment might support you?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Sensory Recipe
tools.purpose: Make a small, situation-specific sensory plan: what to try first, what to use if that is unavailable, and what to notice next.

fields.label: In which kind of moment?
What has helped before?
What tends not to help or is not available?
What small thing could you try next time?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Social Battery
tools.purpose: See what a social interaction gave you, cost you, and what conditions would make it easier next time.

fields.label: Energy before
Energy after
How much effort went into adapting or masking?
What affected your sense of safety or ease?
What recovery or connection would suit you now?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Load Balancer
tools.purpose: See demands as a stack, find what can move, and reduce pressure through one realistic leverage point.

fields.label: What is adding load?
Which one feels heaviest right now?
Which small demand could be delayed, simplified or shared?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Transition Planner
tools.purpose: Make switching activities more visible and less abrupt.

fields.label: What are you leaving?
What are you moving toward?
What unfinished thing keeps your attention behind?
What could make the transition easier?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Start Barrier
tools.purpose: Find the barrier before demanding more willpower.

fields.label: What might be getting in the way?
What could reduce this barrier a little?
What is a meaningful first step, not just a token step?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Motivation Map
tools.purpose: Several motives can coexist—including wanting something and fearing it.

fields.label: What seems to be pulling you?
Where do the motives agree or conflict?
What kind of next step respects the strongest reasons and the constraints?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Friction Finder
tools.purpose: Look for what makes a wanted action harder than it needs to be.

fields.label: Which barriers are present?
Which barrier matters most?
What is one adjustment that could make the action easier?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Small Step
tools.purpose: Find the smallest action that meaningfully changes your position.

fields.label: What are you trying to move toward?
What is one small step that genuinely advances it?
When or where could it happen?
What might make it more possible?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: If–Then Plan
tools.purpose: Pair a likely cue with a response you choose in advance.

fields.label: If this situation or cue happens…
…then I will try this action.
If that plan is not possible, what is a kind backup?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Decision Map
tools.purpose: Compare options across values, costs, uncertainty and effects on others.

fields.label: What are you deciding?
List the options, including waiting or getting more information.
What matters about each option?
What does each ask of you or someone else?
What is not yet known?
Which values are in tension?
How reversible is this choice?
What small step could make the decision clearer?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Future Perspectives
tools.purpose: Consider several time horizons without assuming future-you knows best.

fields.label: What might tomorrow-you appreciate?
What might six-month-you care about?
What might five-year-you wish you had protected?
What matters to you now, too?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Pre-Mortem
tools.purpose: Imagine an option went badly and ask what conditions may have contributed.

fields.label: Which option are you exploring?
Imagine it went badly. What could plausibly have happened?
What early signs could you monitor?
What safeguard or support could reduce avoidable risk?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Decision Review
tools.purpose: Choose what new information would genuinely justify revisiting a choice.

fields.label: What choice have you made for now?
What information would genuinely justify reopening it?
When would you review it, if useful?
What uncertainty can you allow to remain meanwhile?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Pattern Map
tools.purpose: Map context, state, interpretation, urge and consequence without assigning a diagnosis.

fields.label: Trigger or context
Body or state
Interpretation
Feeling or feelings
Urge
What you did
Immediate payoff or protection
Later cost or benefit
What happened next?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Function Finder
tools.purpose: Ask what a response may accomplish before trying to change it.

fields.label: Possible functions—not labels
What does the behaviour help with immediately?
What does it cost later, if anything?
What could meet the same need with fewer costs?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Pattern Experiment
tools.purpose: Change one manageable variable, observe what happens, and update the explanation.

fields.label: What recurring pattern do you want to understand?
What do you think helps generate or maintain it?
What one safe, reversible variable could you change?
What will you observe without forcing an outcome?
What could you learn either way?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Conversation Map
tools.purpose: Separate what was said, intended and heard in a misunderstanding.

fields.label: What happened, as specifically as you can?
What did you say?
What did you mean?
What did they seem to hear?
What did you hear them mean?
What could you ask to check rather than assume?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Needs Clarifier
tools.purpose: Name the request underneath a difficult interaction.

fields.label: What might you be asking for?
What specific request could you make?
What part remains theirs to choose?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Boundary Builder
tools.purpose: Distinguish a preference, request, boundary and attempt to control another person.

fields.label: What situation are you responding to?
Preference: what would you like?
Request: what are you asking the other person to do?
Boundary: what action will you take to care for your own limits?
Rule for myself: what principle do you choose?
Is any part asking to control another person’s choice?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Conflict Map
tools.purpose: Separate facts, interpretations, interests, needs, values, power and possible options.

fields.label: Facts
Interpretations
Interests or goals
Needs
Values
Power or constraints that matter
Any harm or safety concern that needs attention?
Possible agreements, limits or next steps

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Repair Plan
tools.purpose: Consider impact, responsibility and change without forcing reconciliation.

fields.label: What happened?
What impact did it have?
What part is yours to own?
What context matters without erasing impact?
What needs acknowledgement?
What can be repaired, and what needs to change?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Values Discovery
tools.purpose: Notice values in admiration, envy, anger, grief, pride, sacrifice, regret or joy.

fields.label: Choose a starting point
What specific moment are you thinking about?
What mattered or felt protected there?
What other value may be in tension?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Identity Map
tools.purpose: Explore identities and roles as central, chosen, inherited, performed or changing.

fields.label: What roles or identities feel present?
Which descriptions fit some of them?
What overlaps or contradictions do you notice?
What part of you needs more room?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Possible Selves
tools.purpose: Imagine who you could become without needing to discover one fixed “true self.”

fields.label: What kind of person could you become if you had room to grow?
What version of yourself are you afraid of becoming?
What small action points toward a version you choose?
Which expectations may not be yours?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Personal Rules
tools.purpose: Collect rules you have learnt and decide whether they still fit.

fields.label: A rule or belief you notice (e.g. “rest is lazy”).
Where might you have learnt it?
Where does the rule help, and where does it constrain you?
What more flexible rule might fit now?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Two Truths
tools.purpose: Hold apparently conflicting wants without demanding that one disappear.

fields.label: One part of me wants…
Another part of me wants…
What matters to the first part?
What matters to the second part?
What would respect both, even partly?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Life Areas
tools.purpose: Notice where life feels tended, neglected or overloaded—without producing a score.

fields.label: Choose areas you want to consider
Which area feels cared for at present?
Which area wants attention?
What would a small, realistic act of attention look like?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Appreciation
tools.purpose: Slow down around one good detail rather than forcing a list.

fields.label: What happened?
What exactly made it good or meaningful?
Who or what made it possible?
What would have been missing without it?
What detail might you normally overlook?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Difficult Day
tools.purpose: Review demands, supports and learning without asking what is wrong with you.

fields.label: What demanded energy today?
What helped?
What made things harder?
What did you learn?
What can tomorrow inherit from today?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Weekly Review
tools.purpose: Gather patterns, experiments, questions and changes you noticed this week.

fields.label: Patterns noticed
Experiments or attempts
What worked or changed?
Questions still open
Anything repeatedly avoided—and what might it be protecting?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Claim Checker
tools.purpose: Break a claim into what it says, what evidence it needs and what remains unknown.

fields.label: What claim are you checking?
What exactly is being claimed—and about whom or what?
What evidence would be needed to support it?
What do you know, and what is not established?
What competing explanation should be considered?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Evidence Guide
tools.purpose: Compare what different study designs can and cannot tell you.

fields.label: Choose a type of evidence
What question does this evidence answer?
What can it not establish by itself?
What additional evidence would strengthen the conclusion?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Argument Map
tools.purpose: Lay out premises, evidence, inference, conclusion and counterargument.

fields.label: Conclusion or claim
Premises
Evidence for the premises
How does the evidence support the conclusion?
Strongest counterargument
What remains uncertain?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Stim Space
tools.purpose: Explore movement, touch, sound and visual stimulation in the ND play space.
tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Worry Sort
tools.purpose: Separate a practical problem you can act on from a possibility that may need uncertainty-tolerance or support.

fields.label: What is the worry, in one sentence?
Which fits best right now?
If actionable: what is the smallest safe next step? If not: what helps me leave it unanswered for now?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Masking Map
tools.purpose: Map what you adapt, what it protects, what it costs, and where a safer 10% reduction might be possible.

fields.label: Where or with whom do you notice yourself adapting?
What do you change, hide, rehearse, or monitor?
What does this adaptation help protect or make possible?
What does it cost in energy, comfort, or connection?
Is there one safer context where you could choose less effort?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Environment Design
tools.purpose: Change cues, access and friction around an action instead of relying only on willpower.

fields.label: What do you want to make easier?
What in the environment currently gets in the way?
What visible cue or prepared item could help?
What barrier can you remove, reduce, or ask someone to help with?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Reward Design
tools.purpose: Pair a demanding action with a kind, realistic source of interest, comfort or celebration.

fields.label: What effort are you trying to support?
What enjoyable or comforting thing could accompany or follow it?
How can you keep the effort and reward small and available?
Does this reward feel kind rather than like a test you must pass?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Progress Evidence
tools.purpose: Track attempts, learning and recovery—not just finished outcomes.

fields.label: What direction or skill are you practising?
What did you try, even partially?
What changed, got easier, or taught you something?
What would count as a useful next experiment?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Conflict Pattern
tools.purpose: Look for a recurring sequence between people without deciding that one person is the whole problem.

fields.label: What tends to start the sequence?
What does one person do next?
How does the other person respond?
How might each response make sense from that person’s point of view?
What small interruption or clearer request could be worth trying?

tools.storageNote: Explicit maps and account draft wrapper; dedicated key listed where applicable. Opening tested separately; per-tool completion not implied.

tools.title: Positive Memory
tools.purpose: Spend a moment with a specific memory if that feels welcome; you do not need to feel positive.

fields.label: A small moment I would like to remember…
What could I see, hear or notice in it?
What mattered to me about that moment?
Is there a detail, photo or note I want to keep elsewhere?
